question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the following sentence.**

Her visits to her family are very rare because she lives out of the country.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Few and far between**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**Few and far between**" means something is rare or infrequent. (दुर्लभ)

 
 
• **Example**: *The opportunities for promotion in this company are few and far between.*
 
 
 
• It is appropriate for the given sentence because the speaker is describing how seldom the person visits her family.
 
• "**Few**" refers to the small number of visits, while "**far between**" emphasizes the distance or time between them.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Egg on**" means to encourage or provoke someone to do something. (प्रोत्साहित या उकसाना)
 
• "**Beck and call**" means to be at someone's service or command. (किसी की सेवा या आदेश पर होना)
 
• "**All in all**" means considering everything or overall. (हर चीज़ या समग्रता पर विचार करना)

45:Tb1e,
The correct answer is: **Usual**
